blocks.h2: What a Hanover Park Plumbing Inspection Covers
Why Maintenance Matters in Hanover Park
blocks.intro: More than 6 in 10 homes here were built between 1970 and 1989.

items.body: Water heaters, pumps, valves and sewer lines.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: In spring, test the sump pump and battery backup before storm season. In summer, check hoses on the washer and dishwasher for bulges or cracks. In fall, drain outdoor faucets and flush the water heater. In winter, keep an eye on pipes in the garage and near outside walls during cold snaps. A yearly visit from us covers the parts that are harder to check yourself, like the sewer line and gas connections.

blocks.h2: What You Get After a Checkup
blocks.body: A short written summary with each system marked as fine, worth watching or needing attention. We note the age of the water heater and pumps and flag anything near the end of its life. Recommended work comes with a flat price, and you decide when to do it.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should I have a checkup?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rule.

items.q: Does the No Drip Club include checkups?
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits.

items.q: What's most likely to fail in a 1970s home?
items.preview: Water heaters, pumps and shutoff valves.
items.answer: Water heaters, sump pumps and old shutoff valves are the usual first failures.

items.q: Is an inspection useful before buying?
items.answer: Yes. Pair it with a [sewer camera inspection](/hanover-park/video-camera-sewer-inspections).

items.q: How often should washer hoses be replaced?
items.answer: About every 5 years, or sooner if they bulge or crack. Braided steel hoses last longer.

items.q: Can you test my sump pump during the checkup?
items.answer: Yes. We test it with water and check the battery backup.

items.q: How much does plumbing maintenance cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the visit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's included. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
